findings.title: G6 report table mixed formal-run metrics with the protocol-v2 artifact root
findings.evidence: The G6 section of docs/reports/G0_G7_COMPLETE_DATA_CN_20261015.md names results/g6_counterfactual/protocol-g3tools-v2-20261014T030000Z as its artifact root but reports CF1=37/43, CF3=44/25, and ALL=191/186. Read-only reruns prove those values come from the older formal-20261013 verified23 input, while the named v2 plan/private/responses produce CF1=39/45, CF3=32/30, and ALL=181/194. The same stale table is duplicated in G0_G7_METRICS_CN_REPORT.md and G0_G8_TABULAR_DATA_CN.md.
findings.remediation: Do not overwrite raw or historical files. Add a separately sourced protocol-v2 re-audit report with input paths, hashes, command, current metrics, and an explicit non-confirmatory status; retain the old reports as historical snapshots and mark their table provenance clearly in the issue ledger.
